name: Hut 8 Beacon Point AI data center campus
aliases: Beacon Point AI Data Center Campus
summary: Hut 8 AI data center campus on about 521 acres in Nueces County, Texas, backed by 1,000 MW of utility capacity under an AEP Texas interconnection agreement. In 2026 Hut 8 signed two 15-year leases of 352 MW of IT capacity each with one unnamed high-investment-grade tenant, for 704 MW in total, worth about USD 9.8 billion each in base-term value. Hut 8 said in July 2026 that phase 1 construction had begun and phase 2 site preparation was under way; initial energization is targeted for Q1 2027 and the first phase 2 data hall for Q2 2028.

notes: The tenant is not named; Hut 8 describes it as a high-investment-grade company (rated AA- or higher in the notes offering). Leases are triple-net with 15-year base terms worth USD 19.6 billion for the campus. Phase 1 is financed with USD 4.25 billion of non-recourse project notes issued by Beacon Point DC LLC; this is debt financing, not a disclosed project cost. The Energy Mag reports the site was first underwritten for affiliated miner American Bitcoin; Hut 8's releases opened do not say so. Hut 8 names AEP, Vertiv and Jacobs as delivery-model counterparties and an NVIDIA DSX reference design. The 1 GW label refers to utility capacity, not IT load.
